entries.text: A combination of exhausted and a bit of anger . The anger mostly eaten up by the exhaustion in way that is not uncommon for me to feel . Maybe a bit stressed but the exhaustion usually muddles that too , so it ' s hard too gauge .

Revitalized in a sense , I guess the feeling that I feel the strongest is being disconnected from myself in a sort of energizing way . A bit of satisification at the back of the disconnect but also all of that doesn ' t feel right in a sense so there ' s a bit of this "taintedness " behind everything .

A deep exhaustion is what I feel right now with a hint of this sort of aimlessness ? There are literally and more metaphorically a lot of avenues to go down but I feel like I ' ve been spun around emotionally too much for any "direction " to feel right .
Numb , Gray , Lukewarm , Bored , Out of focus

I don ' t feel like I ' m actually feeling much , sort of as if I ' m on most total auto-pilot and I ' m in the passenger ' s side . Out of tone I guess in a sense but I don ' t know , it ' s sort of nice in a sense . It ' s hard to really quantify .

I just feel like I ' m riding a soft wave that ' ll take me where I need to be eventually which isn ' t great but isn ' t bad . There ' s a steady light calm in me , something that comes around often but not forever .
